title: in the reviewer brief, give a go test ./... form that prints only the failing package and test lines, or let ork run the full suite and hand its result over, so a truncated failure can be identified

sections.heading: Why
sections.body:
The reviewer reported this as tool feedback (friction) on ork in ork run ork-20261126-022730-61cc, project ork, item S614:

in the reviewer brief, give a go test ./... form that prints only the failing package and test lines, or let ork run the full suite and hand its result over, so a truncated failure can be identified

Evidence: the first full run exited 1, but internal/daemon stderr filled the output and hid the --- FAIL line; pipes and redirects are not allowed, so I could not filter it
